facts.fact: 她把 Tobias 的眼睛比作想象中的深海：离太阳太远，光只能勉强透进去。
facts.anchor: Like how I imagine the deeper parts of the ocean look

facts.fact: 她听见 Caleb 把一颗子弹推进弹膛的那一下咔嗒声。
facts.anchor: I hear the click as Caleb puts a bullet in the chamber.

facts.fact: 尽管心跳得厉害、几乎喘不上气，她握枪的手依然很稳。
facts.anchor: my hands are steady on the gun

facts.fact: 她把视线收窄到自己能看见的那一小条 Caleb 上。
facts.anchor: I focus, then, on the sliver of Caleb that I can see.

facts.fact: 她认定那个模范 Abnegation 男孩的版本从未存在过。
facts.anchor: That version of him never existed.

facts.fact: 她拿 Tobias 自己说过的话回他：恐惧模拟让人做好行动的准备。
facts.anchor: Fear simulations make people ready to act

facts.fact: Tobias 关上保险，反手把枪塞进牛仔裤腰后。
facts.anchor: He switches the safety on and reaches behind him to tuck it under the waistband of his jeans.

facts.fact: 一声呜咽从她喉咙里冲出来，到一半变成尖叫。
facts.anchor: A sob breaks in my throat.
